faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about Overwatch virtual guarding and remote monitoring.

items.question: Do we need to replace our existing CCTV system?
items.answer: Not necessarily. Overwatch assesses your existing CCTV infrastructure and retains compatible equipment wherever practical. Where equipment is not suitable for the required security objective, we recommend the necessary improvements.

items.question: Does Overwatch replace physical guards?
items.answer: Not automatically. Overwatch can complement guards through remote monitoring, stronger supervision, procedures and incident verification. Depending on the site and security model, better use of technology may also allow guarding resources to be deployed more effectively.

items.question: Does AI make the security decision?
items.answer: No. AI helps identify relevant events. Overwatch operators review alerts and determine whether escalation is required.

items.question: Do you install CCTV?
items.answer: Overwatch assesses the technical requirement and coordinates CCTV installation or upgrades with approved technical partners.

items.question: What happens when an incident is detected?
items.answer: An Overwatch operator reviews the event. If action is required, the incident is escalated according to the protocol agreed with the client.

items.question: Can Overwatch monitor more than one site?
items.answer: Yes. Overwatch can support organisations operating multiple locations, subject to assessment and technical requirements.

items.question: Is the service only for after-hours monitoring?
items.answer: No. Monitoring can be configured according to the requirements of the client and may include after-hours activity, restricted areas, operational events and other agreed periods.

items.question: Can Overwatch help reduce stock loss?
items.answer: Overwatch can improve visibility, detection, accountability and incident investigation around stock and operational areas. Effective loss prevention normally requires a combination of monitoring, procedures, access controls and security management.

items.question: Can Overwatch provide a Security Manager?
items.answer: Yes. Security Manager services are available according to the operational requirements of the client or project.

items.question: How do I know which services I need?
items.answer: Start with a free security assessment. We assess the existing operation and recommend only the services and improvements that are appropriate for the site.

about.title: About Overwatch
about.description: Overwatch is a Mozambique-based security company providing integrated security solutions for businesses and organisations.
paragraphs: We combine AI-powered CCTV monitoring, human verification, security management, technology implementation, operational procedures and incident response.
Our approach begins with understanding how the client's current security operation works.
Where existing systems are suitable, we use them. Where there are gaps, we identify and coordinate the required improvements.
Our objective is simple: To help organisations move from passive security to active, accountable security operations.

items.title: AI-Powered CCTV Monitoring
items.description: AI identifies configured security events and brings them to the attention of our monitoring team. Our operators verify the event and escalate it according to the agreed client protocol. AI detects. People verify. The right team responds.

items.title: Security Assessments
items.description: We assess your CCTV, site vulnerabilities, security procedures, management and response capability before recommending a solution. We identify what can be retained, what needs improvement and where the main security gaps are.

items.title: CCTV & Security Technology
items.description: Where your existing CCTV infrastructure is suitable, we use it. Where improvements are required, Overwatch coordinates the installation, replacement or configuration of cameras and supporting security technology with approved technical partners.

items.title: Security Manager
items.description: Our Security Manager services help clients strengthen the management of their security operations through security assessments, SOP development, guard supervision, incident investigation, reporting and performance monitoring.

items.title: Security Procedures & SOPs
items.description: Overwatch develops and implements practical security procedures covering access control, incident escalation, CCTV operations, guard duties, warehouse security, loading and dispatch, visitor management and emergency response.

items.title: Incident Response
items.description: Detection only matters if someone acts. Overwatch helps establish clear escalation and response procedures for verified incidents.
